content:
Aisha: Heads-up — spotted a strange KMS binding on payments-prod-key granting the group `svc-account-legacy-admins` wide privileges. kicking off an access review. pinging infra + sec.
Devon: Thanks — any customer impact right now?
Aisha: Not yet. audit shows elevated decrypt attempts from an ephemeral canary svc in eu-west1 around 2026-03-21T14:02Z. attaching sample log.
Aisha: ```json
{"timestamp":"2026-03-21T14:02:12Z","principal":"svc-canary-eu@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com","action":"crypto.decrypt","key":"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/payments/cryptoKeys/payments-prod-key"}
```
Irina: Do we have an owner for `svc-account-legacy-admins`? ownerless groups have been the source of a lot of drift.
Aisha: SCIM shows owner=null. plan: 1) create narrow role, 2) migrate callers, 3) then remove the broad binding. also: temporarily mark the binding as "frozen" in our tracker to avoid accidental edits.
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook: https://playbooks.internal/redwood/access-cleanup — follow section "kms-binding-remediation" for step-by-step.
Sam: Freeze binding — what's the quick CLI to remove if we need to emergency rollback?
Aisha: If emergency removal is needed: 
```bash
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding payments-prod-key \
  --member=\"group:svc-account-legacy-admins@redwood.com\" \
  --role=\"roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter\" --location=global --keyring=payments
```
Aisha: For safer path: create role `roles/redwood.kmsPaymentsDecrypt` with only `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt` and bind to specific service accounts. then canary migrate 10% traffic.
sec-bot: Audit: 2 mismatched bindings detected for payments-prod-key. Ticket created: SEC-4321.
Devon: Prefer migration over outright removal. also capture evidence in the access-review doc for compliance.
Aisha: Agree. I'll own remediation. target window to remove old binding: 2026-03-22 17:00 UTC (after canary validation). @Sam can you validate migration steps and run the decrypt smoke tests pre-removal? :pray:
Sam: On it — will run tests in staging and post results here.
Irina: Also add this to the quarterly least-privilege audit sheet and note the ownership gap. link: https://docs.internal/compliance/least-priv-audit-2026
sec-bot: Ticket SEC-4321 assigned to Aisha, due 2026-03-24.
Aisha: I'll update the ticket and the runbook with exact migration commands and paste smoke-test logs here once done. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
